selected_outputs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: canonical full-body transparent mascot image for a web companion sprite animation asset kit.
Input images: Image 1 (SAPA_Welcome_Sticker.png) is the main identity and full-body design reference. Image 2 (SAPA_Chat_Avatar.png) supports face identity, materials and color. These are references, not backgrounds.
Primary request: create ONE neutral standing full-body SAPA mascot, preserving the existing cute green sprout robot faithfully, ready to be the identity master for every subsequent animation pose.
Subject invariants: large rounded emerald helmet, warm ivory faceplate, two dark green oval eyes with small white highlights, little friendly smiling mouth, very faint mint cheeks, cyan circular side-ear accents, exactly two sprout leaves on one short stem above the helmet, small plump green torso with the pale two-leaf emblem, two short arms with ivory tips, two short rounded feet. Match the references' polished soft 3D illustration style. No redesign, no text, no additional markings.
Pose: neutral symmetrical front view; both feet grounded apart; arms relaxed by sides; eyes open; calm friendly smile. Show the entire stem, both leaves, both arms, body and both feet unobstructed.
Composition: square canvas, ideally 1024 x 1024. Center the character horizontally at 50%. Character including leaves occupies approximately x=22% to 78%, y=15% to 84%. Feet rest on the baseline at y=84%; keep generous empty space above the leaves and below the feet. Fixed camera straight on with extremely slight top view as in reference, no perspective distortion.
Lighting: consistent soft studio light from upper left, gentle highlights, crisp readable silhouette, clean refined edges. Very subtle short contact shadow under feet only.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha. No backdrop, scenery, pedestal, card, checkerboard pixels, UI, watermark, labels, lettering or decorative sparkles.
Output: ONE standalone canonical character asset, not a sheet or collage.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE transparent sprite sheet containing exactly EIGHT chronological animation frames of SAPA, arranged in an exact 4-column by 2-row uniform grid. This is a production mascot pose asset, not a poster or illustration scene.
Input image 1 is the canonical identity reference. Preserve its character exactly in every cell: same rounded emerald green helmet, ivory faceplate, dark green glossy eyes, tiny smile, pale mint cheeks, cyan ear rings, exactly two sprout leaves, pale double-leaf chest emblem, short ivory tipped arms and rounded feet. Preserve its soft polished 3D illustration material, top-left lighting, same frontal camera and body proportions. No design variations, accessories except any requested tablet, no change in leaf count or helmet details.
Layout: wide 2:1 canvas, ideally 2048 x 1024. Divide into 4 identical square columns and 2 identical square rows without visible divider lines. Reading order left to right across top row, then left to right across bottom row. Exactly one complete character per cell, eight complete figures total. In every cell, keep center x at 50%, canonical foot baseline y=87%, canonical top leaf y=14%, body height and scale locked. At rest character width about 62% of each cell. Keep the entire pose safely inside its cell, at least 10% clear margins, no figure spilling into adjacent cells. Leave adequate space above leaves for requested jump. Avoid independent auto-cropping or different zoom for different frames.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha in ALL unused areas and spaces between characters. No white or green rectangles, no visible checkerboard texture, no labels, numbers, text, gridlines, borders, stickers, watermarks or scenery. Minimal contact shadow under each figure only.
Animation constraints: coherent small frame-to-frame changes, no random pose changes; eyes and limbs anatomically consistent. This sheet must preserve a single stable identity in all eight frames.
Animation: calm idle breathing and one blink. Keep both feet planted and arms relaxed in all frames. Leaf sway at most 3 degrees; body breathing only 1-2% height. EIGHT frames: 1 neutral open eyes; 2 tiny inhale and leaves softly lean right; 3 eyes half closed; 4 eyes closed as two gentle curved lines; 5 half-open eyes; 6 open eyes and tiny exhale; 7 leaves softly lean left; 8 neutral matching frame 1. Do not wave, jump, turn the body, add props or change the camera. Pose differences deliberately subtle.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent mascot animation sprite sheet, 4 columns x 2 rows, exactly 8 full-body figures, clean uniform square cells, no labels. Use the attached canonical SAPA character as the strict reference for identity, colors, proportions and soft 3D illustration style.
Show the SAME green sprout robot in a simple greeting sequence. CRITICAL: Only the hand on the RIGHT SIDE OF THE IMAGE ever raises. The LEFT SIDE hand stays DOWN against the body in ALL EIGHT frames. Never mirror or swap arms.
Frames reading left to right top row then bottom row: 1 neutral both hands down. 2 right-side hand raised halfway. 3 right-side hand beside face. 4 right-side hand angled outward a little. 5 right-side hand angled inward a little, smiling eyes. 6 right-side hand angled outward again, open eyes. 7 right-side hand lowers halfway. 8 neutral both hands down.
Feet planted on same baseline, identical character size, head straight, stable eyes/helmet/sprout/chest emblem, no camera changes. Leave EMPTY TRANSPARENT padding around every figure, especially at top and between figures. Each figure takes up only about 70% of its square cell height; no clipped leaves. Keep 12% padding on every cell edge.
Genuinely transparent background. Very clean alpha cutout edges. Outside the actual figure silhouette, every pixel is fully transparent. NO shadow, aura, colored halo, green mist, cyan light spill, checkerboard pattern, gray patches, background textures, outline or surrounding glow. No text, labels, extra figures, panels or grid lines. Preserve exactly two leaves on the head.
